definitions.explanation: The act of reorganizing or restructuring an organization, system, or arrangement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再編|さいへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧{再編|さいへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The company announced a business restructuring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧{再編|さいへん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活発化|かっぱつか}→活発化：22450_kappatsuka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Movements toward political realignment are becoming more active.

notes:
{再編|さいへん} refers to fundamentally reorganizing the structure of an organization, system, or political landscape. It implies more substantial change than minor adjustments.

FORMS:
⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) + ⟦{編|へん}→〜編：28472_hen⟧ (compose, organize).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧{再編|さいへん}: organizational restructuring
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧{再編|さいへん}: business restructuring
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧{再編|さいへん}: political realignment
- {再編|さいへん}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: restructuring plan
- {再編|さいへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out restructuring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{改編|かいへん}→改編：17556_kaihen⟧: reorganization (similar but often smaller-scale)
- ⟦{統廃合|とうはいごう}→統廃合：07889_touhaigou⟧: consolidation and merger (combining and closing)
- ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧: reform (broader, can include policy changes)
- ⟦リストラ→リストラ：04689_risutora⟧: restructuring (loanword, often implies layoffs)
